SELECT r.id AS snapshot_id,
    r.session_id,
    r.generated_at,
    r.definition_version,
    r.content_version,
    r.scoring_version,
    r.taxonomy_version,
    r.context_status,
    r.discovery_goal,
    s.locale,
    s.is_internal_test,
    (r.career_areas -> 0) ->> 'areaId'::text AS top_area_id
   FROM cd_report_snapshots r
     JOIN cd_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
  ORDER BY r.generated_at DESC;

SELECT dv.definition_version,
    dv.lifecycle_status,
    g.key AS review_gate,
    g.value = 'true'::jsonb AS cleared
   FROM cd_definition_versions dv
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(dv.review_status) g(key, value)
  WHERE g.value <> 'true'::jsonb AND cd_is_internal_tester(auth.uid());

SELECT DISTINCT ON (profession_id, dimension_id) profession_id,
    calibration_version,
    dimension_id,
    band_low,
    band_high,
    weight,
    centrality,
    evidence_basis,
    confidence,
    source_reference,
    created_at
   FROM cd_profession_profiles
  ORDER BY profession_id, dimension_id, created_at DESC;

SELECT id AS snapshot_id,
    session_id,
    generated_at,
    definition_version,
    content_version,
    scoring_version,
    pattern_definition_version,
    (dna_scores -> 'report'::text) -> 'versions'::text AS versions,
    (dna_scores -> 'report'::text) -> 'locale'::text AS locale,
    patterns AS output_a,
    candidate_story AS output_b,
    career_areas
   FROM cd_report_snapshots s;

SELECT id AS case_id,
    employer_id,
    status,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_core_questions q
          WHERE q.pack_version_id = c.pack_version_id) AS questions_in_pack,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_session_questions sq
             JOIN scp_interview_sessions se ON se.id = sq.session_id
          WHERE se.case_id = c.id AND sq.state = 'answered'::text) AS questions_answered,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_session_questions sq
             JOIN scp_interview_sessions se ON se.id = sq.session_id
          WHERE se.case_id = c.id AND (sq.state = ANY (ARRAY['incomplete'::text, 'revisit'::text, 'not_started'::text]))) AS questions_unresolved,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_session_questions sq
             JOIN scp_interview_sessions se ON se.id = sq.session_id
          WHERE se.case_id = c.id AND sq.state = 'skipped'::text) AS questions_skipped,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT d.id) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_evidence_dimensions d
             JOIN scp_interview_core_questions q ON q.id = d.question_id
          WHERE q.pack_version_id = c.pack_version_id) AS dimensions_in_pack,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT ev.evidence_dimension_id) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_evidence ev
          WHERE ev.case_id = c.id AND ev.evidence_dimension_id IS NOT NULL) AS dimensions_with_confirmed_evidence,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_evidence_proposals p
          WHERE p.case_id = c.id) AS proposals_total,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_evidence_proposals p
          WHERE p.case_id = c.id AND p.review_state = 'pending'::text) AS proposals_awaiting_review,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_evidence_proposals p
          WHERE p.case_id = c.id AND (p.review_state = ANY (ARRAY['edited'::text, 'rejected'::text]))) AS proposals_corrected,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_evidence ev
          WHERE ev.case_id = c.id AND ev.origin = 'human_authored'::text) AS evidence_human_authored,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_findings f
          WHERE f.case_id = c.id AND f.finding_kind = 'verification'::text AND (f.resolution_state = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'needs_verification'::text]))) AS verifications_outstanding,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_findings f
          WHERE f.case_id = c.id AND (f.finding_kind = ANY (ARRAY['gap'::text, 'unclear'::text])) AND f.resolution_state = 'open'::text) AS gaps_open,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_assessments a
          WHERE a.case_id = c.id AND a.level = 0 AND a.superseded_by IS NULL) AS insufficient_evidence_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_assessments a
          WHERE a.case_id = c.id AND a.superseded_by IS NULL) AS assessments_recorded,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT a.assessor_id) AS count
           FROM scp_interview_assessments a
          WHERE a.case_id = c.id AND a.superseded_by IS NULL) AS assessors_involved,
    ( SELECT bool_or(se.process_reflection IS NOT NULL) AS bool_or
           FROM scp_interview_sessions se
          WHERE se.case_id = c.id) AS interviewer_reflected,
    ( SELECT bool_or(se.protocol_deviations IS NOT NULL) AS bool_or
           FROM scp_interview_sessions se
          WHERE se.case_id = c.id) AS protocol_deviation_recorded
   FROM scp_interview_cases c;

SELECT e.subject_id,
    m.competency_version_id,
    cv.competency_id,
    cv.name_sv,
    cv.name_en,
    scp_compute_maturity(e.subject_id, m.competency_version_id) AS maturity_level,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.superseded_by IS NULL) AS live_evidence_count,
    count(DISTINCT e.source_type) FILTER (WHERE e.superseded_by IS NULL) AS source_type_count,
    bool_or(e.safety_finding = ANY (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'critical'::text])) FILTER (WHERE e.superseded_by IS NULL) AS has_safety_flag,
    bool_or(e.requires_human_review AND (e.review_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_review'::text]))) FILTER (WHERE e.superseded_by IS NULL) AS has_open_review,
    max(e.observed_at) AS last_observed_at
   FROM scp_competency_evidence e
     JOIN scp_behaviour_competency_map m ON m.behaviour_version_id = e.behaviour_version_id
     JOIN scp_competency_versions cv ON cv.id = m.competency_version_id
  GROUP BY e.subject_id, m.competency_version_id, cv.competency_id, cv.name_sv, cv.name_en;

SELECT a.id AS assignment_id,
    a.employer_id,
    a.scp_assessment_version_id,
    a.status,
    a.expires_at,
    a.created_at,
    at.id AS attempt_id,
    at.subject_id,
    at.status AS attempt_status,
    at.submitted_at,
    at.scored_at,
    at.released_at
   FROM assessment_assignments a
     LEFT JOIN scp_attempts at ON at.assignment_id = a.id
  WHERE a.scp_assessment_version_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT employer_id,
    recipient_email,
    recipient_user_id,
    use_case AS relationship,
    employee_id,
    application_id,
    job_id,
    count(*) AS assignment_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_count,
    min(invited_at) AS first_invited_at,
    max(invited_at) AS last_invited_at
   FROM assessment_assignments a
  GROUP BY employer_id, recipient_email, recipient_user_id, use_case, employee_id, application_id, job_id;

SELECT hr.id AS review_id,
    hr.trigger_reason,
    hr.review_status,
    hr.opened_at,
    at.issuer_organization_id,
    at.subject_id,
    r.item_version_id,
    r.response_text,
    asr.id AS scoring_run_id,
    asr.run_status,
    asr.min_confidence
   FROM scp_human_reviews hr
     JOIN scp_candidate_responses r ON r.id = hr.response_id
     JOIN scp_attempts at ON at.id = r.attempt_id
     LEFT JOIN scp_ai_scoring_runs asr ON asr.id = hr.scoring_run_id;

SELECT id,
    slug,
    version_number,
    content_status,
    validation_status,
    published_at,
    retired_at,
    core_summary_is_indicative,
    norm_comparison_permitted
   FROM scp_scoring_versions sv;

SELECT t.code,
    t.claim_type,
    t.name_sv,
    t.name_en,
    COALESCE(m.credential_class,
        CASE t.claim_type
            WHEN 'licence'::text THEN 'regulated_authorisation'::text
            WHEN 'training'::text THEN 'mandatory_training'::text
            ELSE 'certification'::text
        END) AS credential_class,
    t.scope_code,
    t.jurisdiction_code AS country,
    t.sub_jurisdiction_code AS region,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM sp_credential_organisation_roles r
              WHERE r.credential_code = t.code AND r.role = 'issuer'::text AND r.document_specific)) THEN NULL::uuid
            ELSE COALESCE(i.id, a.id)
        END AS issuer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM sp_credential_organisation_roles r
              WHERE r.credential_code = t.code AND r.role = 'issuer'::text AND r.document_specific)) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE COALESCE(i.display_name, a.name_local)
        END AS issuer_name,
    COALESCE(d.programme_url, a.official_url) AS official_url,
    COALESCE(d.public_verification_url, i.public_verification_url) AS verification_url,
    i.verification_mode,
    t.requires_valid_until,
    t.allows_no_expiry,
    t.reference_pattern,
    m.original_language,
    d.maintenance_summary_en,
    t.typical_validity_months
   FROM sp_credential_types t
     LEFT JOIN sp_certification_definitions d ON d.credential_code = t.code

          WHERE r.credential_code = t.code AND r.role = 'regulator'::text))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM sp_jurisdictions j

          WHERE j.code = t.sub_jurisdiction_code AND j.is_active))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

          WHERE r.credential_code = t.code AND r.role = 'issuer'::text AND r.document_specific)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

             JOIN sp_authorities ra ON ra.id = r.authority_id AND ra.is_active AND ra.jurisdiction_code = t.jurisdiction_code
